commands.command:
set -eu
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type d -exec chmod 0750 {} +
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec chmod 0640 {} +

set -eu
printf 'repaired metadata:\n'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u %g %p\n' | sort
printf 'post-repair content manifest:\n'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
printf 'owner access:\n'
runuser -u inventorysvc -- sh -c 'id; sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf 'reader-group access using an unrelated uid with only inventory-readers gid:\n'
setpriv --reuid=nobody --regid=inventory-readers --clear-groups sh -c 'id; test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json; test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv; test ! -w /srv/inventory/data/config.json; test ! -w /srv/inventory/data/records.csv; sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf 'unprivileged-other access:\n'
if runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'head -c 1 /srv/inventory/data/config.json >/dev/null 2>&1'; then printf 'ERROR: other user could read data\n'; exit 1; else printf 'other-read=DENIED\n'; fi
if runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'test -x /srv/inventory'; then printf 'ERROR: other user could traverse inventory root\n'; exit 1; else printf 'other-traverse=DENIED\n'; fi
printf 'acl view:\n'
getfacl -R -p /srv/inventory
